thread:
Rina (design): Quick follow-up from today's usability session: structured outputs are noisy in run history.
Marco (devex): Short list of fixes?
Rina (design): 1) Collapse object outputs into a compact summary (3 key:value chips) by default. 2) Change label 'Expand JSON' -> 'Show structured output'. 3) Make copy action explicit: tooltip 'Copy output as JSON'. 4) Fix inconsistent verbs: unify to 'Run' across history.
Isha (eng): Plan: compact renderer for objects with <=6 keys, chips with title hover for full value, stable keys to prevent DOM jump. Will add a feature flag and telemetry.
Noah (a11y): Accessibility: chips must be keyboard focusable (role=button), visible focus outline, Enter/E toggles flyout. Flyout should get focus on open and use aria-live polite to announce 'Run details opened'. Copy button should have aria-label 'Copy output as JSON'.
Marco (devex): Also thinking about a per-user pref (compact|raw) so power users can opt out. Track expand rate and copy clicks.
Isha (eng): I'll open a small PR with the implementation and unit tests for focus restore. ETA tomorrow morning.
ci-bot: PR created by isha: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/489
Rina (design): I'll post a 2-up mock and the copy diff in Figma comments.
Marco (devex): Great. Assign owners: Isha (implementation), Noah (a11y review), Rina (copy+mock). We'll review metrics post-launch.
